review.why: Scores a resume against a job description with a script, then rewrites weak bullets and drafts cover letter hooks.
review.summary: Three workflows: a keyword match score and gap list from a Python script, CAR bullet rewrites with quantification, and cover letter hooks from matched keywords. Two reference guides and a resume template are provided; inputs are plain text files.
strengths: Match score with kept, missing and resume-only keyword lists
States that the score is keyword overlap, not a real ATS
Asks only for the inputs that matter
cautions: License line reads MIT + Commons Clause, which restricts selling
Plain-text inputs only: no PDF or DOCX parsing
The script and references are described, not read in this review
